topIssues.title: Discussion: explicitly use Safe address for `SIGNATURES_<SAFE-ADDR>` env var
topIssues.author: sebastianst
topIssues.body:
Do we want to start appending the affected Safe address that signatures are for for the `just approve` command, like `SIGNATURES_<SAFE-ADDR>`? This is similar to how we specify nonce overrides with `SAFE_NONCE_<SAFE-ADDR>`.

Then all sigs can be exported at once for a nested task and there's less chance of accidentally using wrong sigs and thinking that sigs are wrong.

topIssues.title: Migrate to Blockscout for L2 Block Explorer Needs
topIssues.author: fainashalts
topIssues.body:
We are migrating to Blockscout for OP Mainnet and OP Sepolia. It appears that this repo currently uses Etherscan for checking verified contracts. 

This issue is primarily to do a find every OPM or OP Sepolia reference to Etherscan, replacing with Blockscout. We should also make sure any contracts we are relying on are already verified on Blockscout.

This needs fairly minimal changes to the verification script: 

```
--verifier blockscout 
--verifier-url { https://explorer.optimism.io/api/ | https://testnet-explorer.optimism.io/api }
```

I don't believe you need an API key for blockscout verification.

topPRs.title: U19/Karst gas-limit reset reference tasks for all U19 chains
topPRs.author: sbvegan
topPRs.body:
## Context

Karst (U19) has an op-node / kona-node / kona-program bug that leaves each chain's **effective** L2 block gas limit ~55 MGas above the value stored in its `SystemConfig` after the activation block (see Notion *"P/PS: Karst Gas Limit Bug"*). The approved mitigation (option 2b) is a per-chain **SystemConfig transaction** that re-emits the gas `ConfigUpdate`, resetting the effective gas limit back to the on-chain value.

- Sepolia activates **2026-06-17**; Mainnet **2026-07-08**. These tasks run *after* activation on each network.

## What this adds

Reference `SystemConfigGasParams` tasks for the U19 chains (OP, Ink, Metal, Mode, Zora, Soneium, Unichain) on both networks, each re-affirming the chain's **current on-chain gas params** (`gasLimit` re-set to the same value; EIP-1559 params re-affirmed). The template is used **unmodified** — each task is rooted at the chain's real SystemConfig owner via `safeAddressString = "SystemConfigOwner"` (auto-discovered from `SystemConfig.owner()`).

### Mainnet (`src/tasks/eth/`)
| Task | Chain(s) | gasLimit | eip1559 (denom/elast) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `055-gas-params-op` | OP Mainnet | 40M | 250 / 2 |
| `056-gas-params-ink` | Ink | 60M | 250 / 6 | _(calldata-only — see below)_ |
| `057-gas-params-metal-mode` | Metal + Mode (bundled) | 30M | 250 / 6 |
| `058-gas-params-zora` | Zora | 30M | 250 / 6 |
| `059-gas-params-soneium` | Soneium | 40M | 250 / 10 |
| `060-gas-params-unichain` | Unichain | 60M | 250 / 12 |

### Sepolia (`src/tasks/sep/`)
| Task | Chain(s) | gasLimit | eip1559 (denom/elast) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `101-gas-params-op` | OP Sepolia | 40M | 250 / 2 | _(calldata-only — EOA owner)_ |
| `102-gas-params-ink` | Ink Sepolia | 30M | 250 / 6 |
| `103-gas-params-metal-mode-zora` | Metal + Mode + Zora (bundled) | 30M | 250 / 6 |
| `104-gas-params-soneium-minato` | Soneium Minato | 40M | 250 / 10 |
| `105-gas-params-unichain` | Unichain Sepolia | 60M | 50 / 12 |

These SystemConfigs are owned by the **chain operators**, so the tasks are reference artifacts for the operators to execute via their own owner Safe.

## Notes

- **EIP-1559 `(0,0)` chains** (Ink/Metal/Mode/Zora): their SystemConfig getters return `0` because they predate on-chain EIP-1559 config. They run on the genesis/Canyon defaults from the superchain-registry (`denominator = 250`, `elasticity = 6`), confirmed via the L2 block-header `extraData`. The tasks write these explicitly — a behavioral no-op. (`setEIP1559Params(0,0)` would revert with `denominator must be >= 1`, which is why explicit values are used.)
- **Shared-owner bundling**: Metal+Mode (Mainnet) and Metal+Mode+Zora (Sepolia) share one operator Safe and identical params, so they're bundled into one task each.
- **`055-gas-params-op`** is rooted at the Foundation Upgrade Safe (it owns OP Mainnet's SystemConfig); its nonce override is `59` (live + the two nonces consumed by U19 tasks 053/054). Every config carries a "verify the live nonce before signing" note — nonces and captured hashes are point-in-time.
- **Calldata-only tasks**: OP Sepolia's SystemConfig owner is an EOA (no Safe to simulate), and Ink Mainnet's owner Safe has an EIP-7702-delegated signer that trips the simulator's "owner-with-code ⇒ Safe" heuristic (`MultisigTask` calls `nonce()` on it → revert). Both ship as `README.md`-only with the exact `cast` calldata.

## Validation

All 9 full Safe tasks simulate cleanly via `just simulate-stack` (both per-network stacks). The simulator verifies the data-to-sign against each `VALIDATION.md`, so the recorded **Safe Tx / Domain / Message hashes** are confirmed.

## Follow-up (separate PR)

A gas-limit-only template (`SystemConfigGasLimit`) and the EIP-7702 simulator robustness fix are split into their own PRs.

topPRs.title: migration-src-0: Type A migration exercise tasks (sep)
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Replicates the permissionless **Type A chain-migration exercise** (cf. `migrations-sop-1`, tasks [080–085](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/tree/main/src/tasks/sep)) for **`migration-src-0`** (chainId `420120140`) on Sepolia, migrating it onto the **`migrated-sop-1`** operator infrastructure (the FROM side of this exercise).

> [!IMPORTANT]
> All three tasks are **`DRAFT, NOT READY TO SIGN`**. They are pending review, the out-of-ops ownership transfers, recipient finalization, and re-simulation.

Three tasks, in execution order:

| # | Task | Template | Signer | Status |
|---|------|----------|--------|--------|
| 101 | `set-batcher-unsafe-signer` | `SetBatcherAndOrSigner` | OPE Receiving Safe (`0xb3228B…2B8f`) | DRAFT, NOT READY TO SIGN |
| 102 | `proposer-rotation` | `SetDisputeGameImpl` | ProxyAdminOwner (`0xe934Dc97…40ff`) | DRAFT, NOT READY TO SIGN |
| 103 | `fee-vault-update` | `FeeVaultUpgradeTemplate` | ProxyAdminOwner (`0xe934Dc97…40ff`) | DRAFT, NOT READY TO SIGN |

### What each task does
- **101** — sets `batcherHash` → `0x9bEE5085…865Ce` and `unsafeBlockSigner` → `0x224C4E0a…f90` on `migration-src-0`'s SystemConfig (values read on-chain from `migrated-sop-1`'s live SystemConfig). Simulates cleanly.
- **102** — rotates the **PermissionedDisputeGame (game type 1)** proposer → `0x5e9eE0Aa…eB71` and challenger → `0x9805e797…80D0` (read from `migrated-sop-1`'s DGF). **Prestate left unchanged**; FDG (game type 0) untouched (not registered on this chain). Simulates cleanly.
- **103** — upgrades the 4 fee-vault predeploys to v1.6.0 via 7 portal deposits, with `0xdead…` **placeholder recipients** (replace with real OP-controlled recipients before production signing). Blocked on L2 ProxyAdmin ownership (below).

### Task 103 — L2 ProxyAdmin blocker (surfaced by the `l2RpcUrls` pre-flight)
migration-src-0's **L2 ProxyAdmin** (`0x4200…0018`) is owned by `0x1c784CC0…` (the netchef deployer admin — alias of L1 EOA `0x0b674cc0…`), **not** the aliased L1 PAO (`0xfA45dc97…5210`). The `upgradeAndCall` portal deposits would **revert on L2**. The pre-flight check (`l2RpcUrls`) now enforces this.

**Prerequisite (out-of-ops, like the SystemConfig owner transfer):** transfer L2 ProxyAdmin ownership to the aliased L1 PAO, driven by the current controller (not a PAO-signed ops task). Then re-run `just simulate` and regenerate 103's hashes. Tasks 101/102 are pure-L1 and unaffected.

### Scope decisions (confirmed with task author)
- **Fault proofs out of scope** — no `add-game-type`, no `set-respected-game-type`, no prestate build (102 keeps the existing prestate, skips FDG).
- **SystemConfig ownership transfer out of scope here** — current owner is an EOA (`0x8f6C6dE7…`); the EOA → Safe B transfer is performed **outside this repo**. Task 101 uses a `SystemConfig.owner → Safe B` simulation override.

### Validation (provisional — tasks remain DRAFT)
- **101**: simulates cleanly. Domain `0x3e8aab7b…`, Message `0x9680c059…`, Safe `0x6312d923…`. State diff verified (batcher + signer; Safe B nonce +1).
- **102**: simulates cleanly. Domain `0x07e03428…`, Message `0x8fe01dc7…`, Safe `0x5e633cff…`. State diff verified (PDG proposer/challenger; PAO nonce +1).
- **103**: pre-flight reverts (blocker above). Provisional hashes captured before enabling the check are noted in its VALIDATION.md; regenerate after remediation.

> [!NOTE]
> Nonce overrides assume order 101 (Safe B) → 102 (PAO @ 111) → 103 (PAO @ 112). Re-run `just simulate` to regenerate hashes if on-chain nonces have moved.

topPRs.title: Ink Sepolia migration tasks (Gelato → OP Enterprise)
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Adds the three superchain-ops tasks for the **Ink Sepolia** (`chainId 763373`) rollup-operator migration from **Gelato → OP Enterprise** (Type A Standard OP Stack takeover; cutover **2026-06-22**). Inputs were verified against the _Ink Sepolia Testnet Migration — Engineering Plan_ and cross-checked against live Sepolia state.

| # | Task | Template | Cutover step | Status |
|---|------|----------|--------------|--------|
| 104 | [`ink-sepolia-set-batcher-unsafe-signer`](../tree/af/ink-sepolia-migration/src/tasks/sep/104-ink-sepolia-set-batcher-unsafe-signer) | `SetBatcherAndOrSigner` | 2 & 3 | ✅ simulates; DRAFT |
| 105 | [`ink-sepolia-proposer-rotation`](../tree/af/ink-sepolia-migration/src/tasks/sep/105-ink-sepolia-proposer-rotation) | `SetDisputeGameArgs` | 4 | ✅ simulates; re-sim after U19 |
| 106 | [`ink-sepolia-fee-vault-update`](../tree/af/ink-sepolia-migration/src/tasks/sep/106-ink-sepolia-fee-vault-update) | `FeeVaultUpgradeTemplate` | 15 | ⚠️ **blocked** (see below) |

All three **simulate successfully** on Sepolia (`SIMULATE_WITHOUT_LEDGER=1 just … simulate`). All tasks are **DRAFT, NOT READY TO SIGN**.

## What each task does

### 104 — Set batcher + unsafe block signer
Batches `setBatcherHash` + `setUnsafeBlockSigner` on `SystemConfig` (`0x05C993…bD525`):
- batcher `0x21e57C…002F` (Gelato) → **`0x42c4dBdD6C573b9C2a8657F59EE8E84AE45F2695`** (OPE)
- unsafe signer `0x43ec57…D1a0` (Gelato) → **`0x900C36E0CcAC26F9F49ECa6bbD748e347531864b`** (OPE)

Signed by the **OPE SystemConfig-owner Safe** (`0x837DE4…Fd5E`, 2-of-13). The Gelato→OPE `transferOwnership` is performed off-repo by Gelato (plan step W26); a `SystemConfig.owner()` slot-`0x33` override lets the setters authorize in simulation and **must be removed once W26 lands**.

### 105 — Proposer rotation (proposer-only)
Rotates the **PermissionedDisputeGame** (game type 1) proposer `0xb15d79…4543` (Gelato) → **`0x2282d49d805333D8cd6ddda52B32aC07d6e4e51B`** (OPE) on the DisputeGameFactory (`0x860e62…3D5d`).

Ink's DGF (v1.4.0) uses the **gameArgs blob pattern** (per-chain data lives in `gameArgs(gameType)`, not impl immutables), so `SetDisputeGameArgs` field-diffing is used: only `proposer` is set; **challenger** (`0xfd1d2e…4301`, already the OP Sepolia challenger — OP governance, plan §3.1 "no action") and **prestate** are read live and preserved. Because the prestate is read live, the task is robust to **U19 (2026-06-17)** bumping it — **re-simulate after U19 before signing.** Verified in simulation: the new proposer is set, the old Gelato proposer is fully gone, challenger + prestate unchanged.

### 106 — Fee vault update ⚠️ blocked
Upgrades the 4 fee-vault predeploys to v1.6.0 and re-initializes each recipient via `OptimismPortal2.depositTransaction → L2 ProxyAdmin.upgradeAndCall` (7 deposits). **Two blockers, both documented in the task README/VALIDATION:**

1. **Recipient is a placeholder.** The Kraken fee recipient is an open item in the plan (§1, §3.3 empty placeholder). Current on-chain recipient is the Gelato Safe on L2. `0xdead…00XX` placeholders are used so the state diff is obvious — **replace before signing.**
2. **L2 ProxyAdmin owner = `address(0)`** (verified on-chain, vs. OP Sepolia which returns the aliased L1PAO). The v1.5.0 recipient is immutable, so the change needs a proxy upgrade through the L2 ProxyAdmin — which **reverts on L2** while the owner is unset. **Prerequisite (not in the current plan):** transfer L2 ProxyAdmin ownership to the aliased L1PAO `0x2fc3ff…67f3`. The L1 simulation passes regardless (deposits only emit events on L1) — do not mistake a green L1 sim for a successful L2 effect.

## Verification

- All addresses cross-checked against the migration plan **and** live Sepolia (`SystemConfig`, `DisputeGameFactory.gameArgs(1)`, fee-vault predeploys, safe owners/nonces).
- Domain hashes computed independently and confirmed against the simulation output (104 single-safe; 105/106 nested via the L1PAO = Foundation + Security Council).
- Local simulations succeed for all three (104 produced final domain/message/safe hashes; 105/106 nested message hashes to be regenerated via the nested signing flow before signing).

## Notes for reviewers

- Tasks are numbered **104–106**, following the in-flight `migration-src-0` exercise (101–103) on a separate branch. No directory overlap.
- 105 **must be re-simulated after U19** (2026-06-17); 106 is held until its two blockers are resolved.

topPRs.title: fix(FeeVaultUpgradeTemplate): configure fee vaults via setters, not initialize
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
## Problem

`FeeVaultUpgradeTemplate` upgrades each fee-vault predeploy with `ProxyAdmin.upgradeAndCall(proxy, impl, initialize(recipient, minWithdrawal, network))`.

On any chain whose fee vaults are **already initialized in L2 genesis** (the normal case for live OP Stack chains), this **silently no-ops on L2 while the L1 task tx succeeds**:

- The fee-vault `initialize` uses OpenZeppelin v5's `initializer` modifier (version 1, not a bumped `reinitializer`). The proxies already have `_initialized == 1`, so `initialize` reverts with `InvalidInitialization()` (`0xf92ee8a9`).
- The OP `Proxy.upgradeToAndCall` `require`s the post-upgrade delegatecall to succeed, masking the inner error as `"Proxy: delegatecall to new implementation contract failed"`.
- `upgradeAndCall` reverts → the impl-slot write rolls back → the recipient never changes.
- The L1 portal deposits are still accepted, so the L1 task tx succeeds — the failure is invisible from L1.

The template's pre-flight only checks L2 ProxyAdmin ownership, not the already-initialized case, so this is a confusing land-on-L1 / silently-fail-on-L2 mode.

### Reproduced on-chain (Sepolia devnet `migration-src-0`, chainId 420120140)
- New impls deploy fine; L2 ProxyAdmin is owned by the aliased PAO ✓ (so it is *not* the ownership pre-flight issue)
- Replaying `upgradeAndCall` on L2 reverts with `Proxy: delegatecall to new implementation contract failed`
- Inner error decodes to `InvalidInitialization()`; all four vault proxies read `_initialized = 1` at the OZ-v5 namespaced slot

## Fix

Deposit `ProxyAdmin.upgrade(proxy, impl)` (no initializer call), then configure via the v1.6.0 storage setters `setRecipient` / `setMinWithdrawalAmount` / `setWithdrawalNetwork`. Each setter is gated by the L2 ProxyAdmin owner — the aliased rootSafe these portal deposits already execute as — so it works whether or not the proxy was previously initialized. Same approach as the existing `RevShareCommon.configureVaultsForRevShare` helper.

Per vault: **1 `upgrade` + 3 setters** (was 1 `upgradeAndCall`); `_validate`'s expected action count updated accordingly.

## Verification
- `forge build` ✓
- Regression fixtures in `testRegressionCallDataMatches_FeeVaultUpgradeTemplate` regenerated for the new deposit pattern: `expectedCallData` is now 14 deposits (2 CREATE2 deploys + 3 `upgrade` + 9 setters), plus the nested-multisig `expectedDataToSign` for Foundation + Council. The regenerated data-to-sign **domain hashes match the previous pinned values exactly** (they are override-driven / block-independent), and the calldata was verified selector-by-selector (`upgradeAndCall` gone, `upgrade`×3, 14×`depositTransaction`). CI's archive-fork run at the pinned block is the authoritative regression check.

## Follow-ups (out of scope here)
Tasks that consume this template must be re-simulated and their VALIDATION hashes regenerated, since the generated calldata changes:
- `src/tasks/sep/085-migrations-sop-1-fee-vault-update`
- the in-flight `migration-src-0` fee-vault task ([#1463](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/pull/1463))
